Resolves #21747

The timeline's editor now marks the part of a bound that changed when it refuses a save: the time field when only the time moved since the editor opened, else the date field. That is the rule `validateBound` already follows for a bound that does not parse. One method, `EventEditor#getBoundErrorField()`, serves both refusals in `save()`: an end before the start, and an owner refusal (`commitTimelineEdit`) on a bound. The scheduler's minimum-duration refusals from #21724 now sit under the time field a person changed.

Evidence: L3 (unit specs plus a headless Chromium e2e) → L2 required (AC-1..AC-4 name field states a unit spec reads). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/scheduler/Container.spec.mjs` › "the editor below the minimum (#21722)" (owner refusals on the End and the Start), `test/playwright/unit/timeline/EventEditor.spec.mjs` › "an end before the start marks the part of the end that changed: its time on the same day, else its date", and `test/playwright/e2e/timeline/EventEditor.spec.mjs` › "keeps a refused End time in its row, its message on one line beneath it and Save in place (#21747)" |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: the same editor unit test's date part, and the e2e "keeps a refused End date in its row, its message on one line beneath it and Save in place" for the Gantt and the scheduler |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: the three #21722 tests read `endDate__time` / `startDate__time` and expect no error on the date field |
| AC-4 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/timeline/EventEditor.spec.mjs` › "a bound whose time is unreadable or cleared refuses to save and marks its time field, never midnight", unchanged |

## Deltas from ticket

- An e2e case renders a refused End time. No spec showed a time field's message, so the ticket's "moving the mark needs no layout change" is now measured: one line, in the End row, clear of Progress, Save in place. The date case's assertions moved into `expectRefusedInRow()`, which both cases share, and each asserts which field carries the message.
- From review 6005374522: `save()` now clears the last attempt's errors before its checks, so a refusal on the same open draft no longer leaves the earlier message on the other field of its row. Like open, cancel and every successful save before it, the clear also hides a field validator's message until that field changes again.
- Intake: the drift probe since the ticket's filing found no commit on its edit surface.

## Test Evidence

- Red-first: with `dev`'s `src/timeline/EventEditor.mjs` swapped in, the three minimum-duration tests and the new editor test fail (4 of 25), and the e2e time case fails on "neo-timefield carries the message". The editor test's same-draft step also fails at `bfe97eef9b`, where the End time keeps its message beside the End date's. At `a87edcf968` all pass: 25 unit, 7 e2e.
- The other specs that load the editor pass at `bfe97eef9b`: `unit/gantt/Editor`, `unit/timeline/EventDragZone` and `unit/apps/workstation/PlanningStores` (24), plus `e2e/gantt/EditorFocus`.
